event.summary: Legacy Planned checkout refusal is preceded by an absence check
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 647f0227b7f5b6c5fe443b2d5f0c4a20de0d5513. Original suspected consequence: retry could forget an existing checkout directory and its deletion handle by rolling back Planned ownership after mkdir but before identity capture. Source investigation confirms that mkdir-before-identity crash window exists (working_copies.rs:1421–1439), and rollback_pre_mkdir_create itself checks no filesystem evidence (store.rs:3595–3627). Only absent candidates reach the new refusal's Planned rollback; existing ambiguous directories retain their records through the earlier refusal. This refutes the suspected shipped legacy crash route. Could-be-highest: no established loss of user-owned work; original concern was lost ownership metadata, and no deletion occurs here. Suggested bucket: other if the premise had held. Confidence: confirmed source refutation, not runtime observed. proposed_drop: refuted by core.rs:10059–10082 before launch_reserved. possible_cover: none. No runtime tests or reproductions run.

event.detail: Reviewed commit: 647f0227b7f5b6c5fe443b2d5f0c4a20de0d5513. That test removes the agent pane, proves one marked tmux tab remains the only window, asserts NothingAlive refuses because of the tab, then clears the in-memory agent terminal and verifies both ordinary listing and the guard still see it. At the reviewed revision the new-terminal creation path is retired, but the old-tab service contract is not: SPEC_impl.md:2956–2958 says 'its old tabs staying in tmux until they are closed'; 2973–2975 explicitly describes queries when a session has no terminal; 2998–3002 requires tab rediscovery by marker. Replacing this oracle with a host-only test cannot exercise the tmux marker-query/lone-window boundary. Available replacement checks: e2e/session_lifecycle.rs:3646–3697 and 3707–3759 assert an ended agent plus one host tab, but do not remove the agent terminal; core/tests/host_terminals.rs:329–382 supplies None for the agent plus a host tab that becomes unavailable and asserts cannot-tell refusal, not ordinary lone-live-tab listing/count; e2e/host_tabs.rs:1058–1138 and 1155–1223 exercise unavailable tabs after Stop, not this oracle. tmux/control_codec.rs:1466–1492 retains a pure marker-query decision test for a lone marked window, but never exercises supervisor listing, guard selection or an absent agent. Bounded symbol searches for all still_alive_for_delete and NothingAlive sites in supervisor core/tests and e2e identified no equivalent integrated replacement. The deleted tab is marked by open_tab; it is not an unmarked-shell cleanup test, and parent-reported g103/f1 concerns a separate oracle. Suggested remedy: construct/adopt a legacy tmux fixture directly (tmux driver tests still have private servers), then retain the listing and NothingAlive assertions with the agent pane gone and with terminal=None; retirement of tmux creation need not retire tests of still-supported adoption. Suggested bucket: other (maintainer test coverage only). Caveat: production currently contains the correct marker-aware guard, and omission is not evidence that runtime behavior is broken.
